summary: Toyota Motor filed a Form 6-K, the US equivalent of a foreign private issuer current report, disclosing September buyback activity under a board authorization dated August 4, 2026. The company repurchased 35,554,800 common shares for JPY 108,506,196,300 between September 1 and September 30, 2026, via open-market purchases. The authorization permits up to 500 million shares or JPY 1,000 billion through August 4, 2027. Cumulative repurchases reached 63,766,500 shares for JPY 195,000,372,200 as of September 30. Watch execution pace against the JPY 1,000 billion cap and any anti-dilution or capital-allocation signals.
